europe_now.title: US Policy Shift and Sanctions on Russian Diesel
europe_now.summary: The United States has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, prompting discussions among American, European, and Ukrainian officials regarding new proposals to end the ongoing war. Officials are actively engaging in joint talks to coordinate diplomatic and security strategies in response to these developments.

sources.headline: 'Constructive discussions': US, Europe and Ukraine work on joint plan to end war

europe_now.title: Ukrainian Cyber and Physical Strikes on Russian Tech Infrastructure
europe_now.summary: Recent Ukrainian strikes targeting critical data centers have severely disrupted operations for major Russian search engine and technology services. These actions highlight the growing digital and infrastructural dimension of the ongoing conflict between the two nations.

sources.headline: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres

top_stories.title: Nobel Peace Prize Awarded to Navi Pillay
top_stories.summary: South African judge Navi Pillay has been awarded the prestigious Nobel Peace Prize in recognition of her lifelong dedication to human rights. While international leaders have widely praised the decision, Israel expressed a dissenting voice regarding the announcement.

sources.headline: Navi Pillay awarded Peace Prize: 'Lifetime spent fighting for what's right & to uphold human rights'

top_stories.title: Environmental Pressures on European Rivers and Agriculture
top_stories.summary: Major European rivers are currently drying up, posing a significant threat to regional energy security and international trade. Meanwhile, scientists and pesticide victims have voiced strong concerns regarding potential regulatory rollbacks within the European Union.

sources.headline: ‘So safe you could drink it’: Scientists and pesticide victims fear an EU rollback
